from z3 import *

n = 24

# Variables for positions
x = [Int(f'x_{i}') for i in range(n)]

# Each x_i in 0..n-1
domain = [And(x[i] >= 0, x[i] <= n-1) for i in range(n)]

# All distinct
distinct = Distinct(x)

# Differences
d = [Int(f'd_{i}') for i in range(n-1)]

# d_i = |x_{i+1} - x_i|
abs_constraints = []
for i in range(n-1):
    abs_constraints.append(
        Or(
            And(x[i+1] >= x[i], d[i] == x[i+1] - x[i]),
            And(x[i] < x[i+1], d[i] == x[i+1] - x[i])  # wait this is wrong
        )
    )

# Actually: d_i = |x_{i+1} - x_i|
# d_i == If(x[i+1] >= x[i], x[i+1] - x[i], x[i] - x[i+1])
for i in range(n-1):
    abs_constraints.append(
        d[i] == If(x[i+1] >= x[i], x[i+1] - x[i], x[i] - x[i+1])
    )

# d_i in 1..n-1
diff_domain = [And(d[i] >= 1, d[i] <= n-1) for i in range(n-1)]

# All d_i distinct
diff_distinct = Distinct(d)

s = Solver()
s.add(domain)
s.add(distinct)
s.add(abs_constraints)
s.add(diff_domain)
s.add(diff_distinct)

print("Solving...")
result = s.check()
print("Result:", result)

if result == sat:
    m = s.model()
    sol = [m.evaluate(x[i]).as_long() for i in range(n)]
    print("Solution:", sol)
    # Verify
    diffs = [abs(sol[i+1] - sol[i]) for i in range(n-1)]
    print("Diffs:", sorted(diffs))
    print("All distinct diffs:", len(set(diffs)) == n-1)
    print("All diffs in 1..n-1:", all(1 <= d <= n-1 for d in diffs))
